queries_run: AXT Inc indium phosphide export permit China 2026

findings.claim: 中國自2025-02-04起對InP基板實施出口許可；10-K稱InP出口許可是目前最大挑戰，且無法保證取得許可或中國不再加碼管制
findings.excerpt: On February 4, 2025, China added indium phosphide substrates to its export control list. On March 4, 2025, the United States further increased the tariff on imports of many products, including our wafer substrates, to 70%. InP export permits represent the most significant challenge we currently face.

findings.claim: 美國對含晶圓基板的中國進口品關稅升至70%，北美營收2025年僅約2%；IEEPA關稅於2026-02-20被最高法院推翻，但232與301仍有效
findings.excerpt: On February 20, 2026, the U.S. Supreme Court invalidated many of the global tariffs previously imposed under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act of 1977 (the "IEEPA") and the U.S. Customs and Border Protection subsequently announced that IEEPA-based tariff provisions would be terminated effective February 24, 2026.

findings.claim: 搜尋摘要：最新424B5稱對美國客戶的InP出口許可處於最終審查階段、尚未核發；Q2 2026 10-Q稱仍有未取得許可的訂單積壓且無法預測審批時點

note: US許可是否已核發未查到；as_of為估計
